questions.text: Design a real-time pipeline to aggregate health metrics from 500 million Apple Watch devices. The system must support differential privacy guarantees and process data both on-device and in the cloud.
You have a Spark job that runs fine on 10GB of data but fails with OutOfMemoryError on 1TB. Walk me through your debugging process step by step.
Explain the difference between a narrow and wide transformation in Spark. What happens during a shuffle and how would you minimize shuffle overhead in a join-heavy pipeline?
Design a schema evolution strategy for a data pipeline that serves 50 downstream teams with different SLAs. Some teams need backward compatibility, others can tolerate breaking changes.

Given a table of user events with timestamps, write a SQL query to find users who had sessions of more than 30 minutes where a 'session' is defined as a sequence of events with no gap longer than 5 minutes.

experiences.notes: Interviewer was very terse. Asked 'why not X?' multiple times. Deep follow-ups on Spark memory model. Privacy came up in almost every system design question.
